tasks.title: Design and implement smart reminders

tasks.done_criteria: Smart reminders are implemented and tested in the app.

tasks.title: Prepare for App Store and Google Play submission
tasks.description: Gather all required assets, including app descriptions, screenshots, and metadata for both app stores.
tasks.done_criteria: All required assets for app store submission are ready.

tasks.title: Test v2 release internally
tasks.description: Conduct internal testing of the app to ensure all features work as expected and the app is stable.

tasks.description: Complete the submission process for both app stores, including review and approval.

tasks.description: Track user engagement, crash-free sessions, and app store ratings after the release to measure the impact of v2.

tasks.title: Define crash-free session criteria and baseline

tasks.title: Analyze crash logs and identify common causes
tasks.description: Review crash logs from the last quarter to identify patterns, common errors, and potential root causes of crashes.
tasks.done_criteria: Crash logs analyzed and common causes identified.

tasks.title: Implement crash fixes for identified issues
tasks.description: Fix the most critical crash issues identified in the logs, focusing on the most frequent and impactful errors.
tasks.done_criteria: Critical crash issues fixed and tested.

tasks.title: Test crash fixes with a small user group
tasks.description: Deploy the fixes to a small subset of users and monitor for any new crashes or regressions.
tasks.done_criteria: Crash fixes tested and validated with a small user group.

tasks.title: Monitor crash-free sessions and track progress
tasks.description: Track crash-free session metrics over the next few weeks, including a mid-quarter check and final measurement.
tasks.done_criteria: Crash-free session metric tracked and progress measured.

tasks.title: Revise and finalize crash-free session strategy
tasks.description: Based on the metrics and feedback, refine the approach to ensure the target of 99.5% is met.
tasks.done_criteria: Crash-free session strategy revised and finalized.

tasks.title: Define user growth strategy
tasks.description: Outline the approach to grow MAU from 4,000 to 7,000, including tactics like onboarding improvements, referral programs, and marketing channels.

tasks.title: Prepare user onboarding improvements
tasks.description: Design and prototype enhancements to the onboarding flow to increase user engagement and retention.

tasks.title: Implement onboarding improvements
tasks.description: Develop and deploy the improved onboarding flow to the app.
tasks.done_criteria: The improved onboarding flow is live in the app and accessible to all users.

tasks.title: Design referral program
tasks.description: Create a referral program that incentivizes users to invite friends to the app.
tasks.done_criteria: A referral program design document is completed and ready for implementation.

tasks.title: Implement referral program
tasks.description: Develop and deploy the referral program functionality in the app.
tasks.done_criteria: The referral program is live in the app and accessible to all users.

tasks.title: Launch marketing campaign
tasks.description: Plan and execute a marketing campaign to attract new users, including social media, email, and app store optimization.
tasks.done_criteria: A marketing campaign is launched and running across multiple channels.

tasks.title: Track and measure MAU growth
tasks.description: Monitor the monthly active users metric throughout the quarter and report progress.

tasks.title: Review and refine strategy
tasks.description: Analyze the effectiveness of the growth tactics and refine the strategy based on user feedback and data.
tasks.done_criteria: A refined growth strategy is documented and ready for the next quarter.

tasks.done_criteria: Criteria and tools for tracking store ratings are defined and documented.

tasks.done_criteria: Rating improvement strategies are implemented for Google Play.

tasks.title: Monitor and adjust rating improvement efforts: part 1
tasks.description: Track the impact of rating improvement strategies in real time, using the tools identified in step 1. Adjust strategies as needed based on performance data for App Store.
tasks.done_criteria: Rating improvement efforts are monitored and adjusted for App Store based on real-time data.

tasks.title: Monitor and adjust rating improvement efforts: part 2
tasks.description: Track the impact of rating improvement strategies in real time, using the tools identified in step 1. Adjust strategies as needed based on performance data for Google Play.
tasks.done_criteria: Rating improvement efforts are monitored and adjusted for Google Play based on real-time data.

tasks.title: Measure final store rating and compare to baseline

tasks.done_criteria: Final store rating is measured and compared to the baseline.

tasks.title: Define conversion goals and user segments
tasks.description: Set up conversion tracking in Firebase and identify user segments (e.g., active users, inactive users, new users) that are most likely to convert.

tasks.title: Design and implement a free-to-paid conversion funnel
tasks.description: Create a funnel that guides users from the free version to the paid subscription, including onboarding, in-app prompts, and a clear call-to-action.

tasks.title: Analyze conversion data and identify bottlenecks
tasks.description: Review the conversion data from the A/B tests and identify where users are dropping off in the funnel.

tasks.title: Revise the conversion funnel based on data insights
tasks.description: Make adjustments to the conversion funnel based on the analysis, such as improving onboarding, optimizing prompts, or adjusting pricing.

tasks.title: Measure the final conversion rate and compare to baseline
